experiment.title: Weak acid titration: pKa of an unknown monoprotic weak acid
experiment.goal:
sample is an aqueous solution of an unknown monoprotic weak acid HX. Determine the pKa of HX at room temperature.
When done, submit with submit_result: quantity = "pKa", unit = "".

ftir_1.model: Thermo Fisher Nicolet iS5 + iD7 ATR

flow_1.model: Vapourtec R-Series (R2+ pump module / R4 reactor module)

foam_1.model: self-built DIY foam rig (cylinder + air pump + webcam)

sample.label: Unknown monoprotic weak acid HX solution, ~0.1 M, pKa unknown (estimated 4–5), 100 mL total

spec.external_sensor: PT1000 (once connected, enables closed-loop control on liquid temperature)

to_calibrate: plate_to_liquid_W_per_K (varies with vessel and liquid volume)

spec.notes: Flow range depends on syringe inner diameter

to_calibrate: Actual dispensed volume vs setpoint (weigh on a balance)
Electrode slope and zero point (two/three-point calibration)
Cell constant (calibrated with standard KCl solution)
Bath-to-vessel heat transfer coefficient (varies with immersion depth and glassware)
Bath-to-vessel heat transfer coefficient (varies with immersion depth and glassware)
Evaporation rate (varies with solvent, rotation speed, condenser efficiency)
Actual photon flux (chemical actinometer, e.g. potassium ferrioxalate)
IR temperature vs in-vial fibre-optic temperature (IR reads the outer wall; offset can be several °C)

flow_1.model: R-Series (R2+ pump module / R4 reactor module)

spec.coil: 10 mL PFA coil (1 mm ID), can be used as two 5 mL coils in series with a T-piece in between for a third feed

to_calibrate: Inline UV flow cell pathlength (with standards of known concentration)
Actual coil volume (tracer residence time distribution)
kLa at different stirring speeds (measured by sulfite oxidation or H2 pressure drop)
autoclave_1.sim_model_version: autoclave-sim/0.1 (ideal gas headspace + kLa mass transfer)

to_calibrate: Check with standard latex beads (e.g. 60 nm polystyrene)
In-flask liquid temperature vs chamber temperature
Other polymers need universal calibration or Mark–Houwink parameters (not modelled in the simulation)
Lag of sample temperature inside the crucible

foam_1.model: DIY foam rig (cylinder + air pump + webcam)
to_calibrate: Air-stone pore size (sets initial bubble size)
